title: Add arm64 platform support to goldenbraid justfile
description: The justfile currently only builds for linux/amd64. It should also support linux/arm64 for multi-arch builds. This requires adding multi-arch build recipes (or updating platform variable) and potentially a new Dockerfile.multiarch per project conventions.
close_reason: Added platform_multi variable and push-multi/push-ghcr-multi recipes to justfile. Dockerfile.goldenbraid already supported multi-arch via BUILDPLATFORM/TARGETOS/TARGETARCH args.
